euPresence.warehouses: Bremen, Germany (Senator-Blase-Strasse 13, 28197) per its shipping policy; items out of stock there ship from China in 8-12 business days.
euPresence.euStoreEntity: de.gmktec.com terms name Shenzhen GMK Technology Co., Ltd (China) as operator, governed by Hong Kong law. No EU-based seller entity or VAT ID found.
euPresence.vatOrOssHandling: Shipping policy says it ships from Germany to avoid extra EU taxes and, for China shipments, declares reduced product values to minimise import duties and customers may face customs fees. No VAT ID or OSS registration shown. Treat for B2B invoicing as unresolved.
euPresence.returnAndWarrantyAsWritten: Global store: '7 days to return an item from the date you received it'; 15% restocking fee on opened or used items; '1-year warranty from the date of order placement'; 'No return/refund will be accepted after 15 days of receipt'. The EU store's own numeric terms were not shown in the fetched AGB. The global policy conflicts with the EU 14-day withdrawal right and 2-year legal guarantee (inference; reviewers on Trustpilot raise the same). A later legal check found GMKtec's own pages disagree: its FAQ states 60 calendar days from the shipment date with a 15% restocking fee on non-fault returns, and its German page states a two-year warranty (see verification item l10). The EU 14-day withdrawal right protects consumers only, and a flat 15% fee on a consumer withdrawal sits uneasily with Directive 2011/83 Article 14(2); counsel should confirm.
